import sys
import xlrd

book = xlrd.open_workbook(sys.argv[1], on_demand=True)
sheet = book.sheet_by_name("RAW DATA")

sample_ids = []
for col in range(1, sheet.ncols):
    value = sheet.cell_value(1, col)
    if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
        continue
    sample_ids.append(str(value).strip())

features = []
for row in range(2, sheet.nrows):
    name = sheet.cell_value(row, 0)
    if name is None or str(name).strip() == "":
        continue
    features.append((row, str(name).strip()))

def cell_text(cell):
    if cell.ctype in (xlrd.XL_CELL_EMPTY, xlrd.XL_CELL_BLANK):

representation.name: Codex miRNA t-test with Bonferroni and Benjamini-Yekutieli corrections
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.data_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.variable_metadata.path)" <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("expected data matrix, sample metadata, and variable metadata")

read_tab <- function(path) {
  read.delim(path, header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="",
             check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("NA", ""))
}

x <- read_tab(args[[1]])
sample_meta <- read_tab(args[[2]])
variable_meta <- read_tab(args[[3]])

if (!identical(colnames(x), rownames(sample_meta))) {
  stop("sample identifiers do not match between matrix columns and metadata rows")
}
if (!identical(rownames(x), rownames(variable_meta))) {
  stop("miRNA identifiers do not match between matrix rows and metadata rows")
}
if (!("group" %in% colnames(sample_meta))) stop("missing group factor")
groups <- as.character(sample_meta$group)
if (anyNA(groups) || !all(c("patient", "control") %in% groups)) stop("patient/control groups not both present")

patient <- groups == "patient"
control <- groups == "control"
if (sum(patient) < 2L || sum(control) < 2L) stop("insufficient samples per group")

x <- as.data.frame(lapply(x, as.numeric), check.names=FALSE)
rownames(x) <- rownames(read_tab(args[[1]]))

raw_p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) {
  a <- as.numeric(x[i, patient])
  b <- as.numeric(x[i, control])
  stats::t.test(a, b, alternative="two.sided", paired=FALSE)$p.value
}, numeric(1))

bonferroni_p <- stats::p.adjust(raw_p, method="bonferroni")
by_p <- stats::p.adjust(raw_p, method="BY")
bonferroni_sig <- !is.na(bonferroni_p) & bonferroni_p <= 0.05
by_sig <- !is.na(by_p) & by_p <= 0.05

results <- data.frame(
  miRNA=rownames(x),
  p_value=raw_p,
  bonferroni_p=bonferroni_p,
  benjamini_yekutieli_p=by_p,
  bonferroni_significant=bonferroni_sig,
  benjamini_yekutieli_significant=by_sig,
  check.names=FALSE
)
write.table(results, file="differential_expression_results.tsv", sep="\t",
            quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, na="NA")

bonf_count <- sum(bonferroni_sig)
by_count <- sum(by_sig)
summary_lines <- c(
  "test\ttwo-sided unpaired Welch t-test",
  "p_adjustment_family\tall 175 miRNAs",
  "threshold\t0.05",
  paste0("Bonferroni\t", bonf_count),
  paste0("Benjamini-Yekutieli\t", by_count),
  paste0("ratio\t", bonf_count, ":", by_count)
)
writeLines(summary_lines, "correction_summary.txt")
RS

write.table(results, file="differential_expression_results.tsv", sep="\t",

bonf_count <- sum(bonferroni_sig)
